3. Abdominal

Cybex Prestige Strength

Abdominals · seated crunch

Setup: Adjust foot bar for a bend at the knees. Extend legs to keep back firmly against pad while keeping slight bend at the knees. Grasp handles, lean back while extending arms. Motion: Push handles by bending from trunk while keeping arms fully extended.

11. Triceps Extension

Life Fitness

Triceps

Placard steps: 1. Adjust seat height so you are able to comfortably grip handles. 2. Rotate handles back and grip firmly. 3. While keeping back against pad and elbows close to side of body, extend elbow slowly while keeping upper arms parallel and on pad, and return.
